title: 9/18/2026 | Robert & Lyn Pool | COM | Support for Request for Independent Investigation and Forensic Audit PUC Docket 59475 Item No. 6571

documents.text:
=== Sept. 18, 2026.docx ===
TO:  The Public Utility of Texas
FROM:  Robert and Lyn Pool
DATE:  September 18, 2026
RE:  PUC Docket 59475 Item No. 6571 Support for Request for Independent Investigation and Forensic Audit

We support Kevin Kennedy and John M. Burrows request in Item 6571 for an Independent Technical Investigation and Forensic Audit of the modeling underlying in the 2024 Permian Basin Reliability Plan.

Before thousands of acres of private property are taken and changed forever it just makes sense that an Independent Investigation should take place.  For a project that is this large and this expensive it should just be common sense to have everything that it entails verified and then verified again.  Once ground is broken and towers are erected, that cannot be undone and we want to be sure and get it right before irreparable harm is done.

This filing asks some very important questions that have not been independently verified and answered and I think we speak for many of us who would like some answers to those questions that so far have not been provided. 

We also support the requested pause while that work is completed and reviewed.  Our support for an audit does not presume misconduct or a predetermined result.  It reflects the importance of getting decisions of this scale right.  
 
Respectively,
Robert and Lyn Pool
Pro Se Intervenors
Lampasas, TX  76550
